commands.author: Pick-cat

target.title: fix(ollama): dripping model pulls hang past idle timeout during setup
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where OpenClaw Ollama setup could hang forever while downloading a model when `/api/pull` kept sending occasional NDJSON progress lines that never advanced `completed`.

Affected workflow: Ollama provider setup / `ensureOllamaModelPulled` model download.

## Why This Change Was Made

Ollama setup already aborts if headers never arrive (30s) and already fails if the pull stream goes fully idle (300s). After headers return, that response timer was cleared, so only the per-chunk idle timer remained. Idle resets on every chunk, so a slow drip can keep the download alive indefinitely.

This keeps the headers and byte-idle budgets as-is, then arms a **no-progress watchdog** after the first body chunk. The watchdog resets when aggregate Ollama `completed` increases **or when the pull status transitions to a new distinct phase** (e.g. from "downloading" to "verifying sha256 digest" to "writing manifest"), so:
- non-advancing drips fail closed
- advancing large/slow downloads may continue past any fixed wall-clock lifetime
- healthy post-download finalization phases are not aborted

Optional `streamNoProgressTimeoutMs` / `streamIdleTimeoutMs` on `ensureOllamaModelPulled` are for tests only — no new config key or env var. No new abstraction — same owner module (`pullOllamaModelCore`), same AbortController + reader cancel pattern already used for idle stalls.

Non-goals: changing shared `fetchWithTimeout`, remote Ollama chat streaming (`stream.ts`), or adding a hard total lifetime cap.

**Collision check:** `path:extensions/ollama/src/setup.ts` open PRs = 0 for this timeout policy. Nearby open ollama PRs touch streaming/NDJSON elsewhere, not setup pull no-progress.

## User Impact

During Ollama setup, a wedged or maliciously dripping `/api/pull` stream (bytes without advancing `completed`) fails closed with a no-progress error instead of hanging the wizard forever. Healthy pulls that keep advancing `completed` or transition through documented status-only finalization phases (verifying, writing manifest, cleanup) are no longer cut off. True idle stalls still fail at 300s with the existing no-data message.

## Evidence

Exact head: `48f6450aea9f9e9eb9ed7f70e8f3ffd388eddb21`

### Focused tests

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/ollama/src/setup.test.ts extensions/ollama/src/setup.pull.test.ts extensions/ollama/src/setup.pull-deadline.loopback.test.ts -- --run --reporter=verbose
```

```text
 ✓ pulls model when not available locally
 ✓ fails stalled model pull streams after an idle timeout
 ✓ bounds a non-advancing drip with a no-progress timeout
 ✓ allows advancing completed progress past the shortened no-progress timeout
 ✓ allows status-only finalization past the shortened no-progress timeout
 ✓ skips pull when model is already available
 ✓ skips pull when an untagged model is available as latest
 ✓ uses baseURL alias when checking and pulling models
 ✓ skips pull for cloud models
 ✓ skips when model is not an ollama model
 ... (29 setup tests)
 ✓ does not settle a dripping /api/pull body under idle timeout alone
 ✓ aborts a non-advancing dripping /api/pull body within the no-progress timeout
 ✓ allows status-only finalization past the shortened no-progress timeout
 ✓ allows advancing completed progress past the shortened no-progress timeout

 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  43 passed (43)
```

Coverage:
- existing idle-stall regression still green at 300s with **no data** message (empty body; no-progress not armed)
- fake-timer non-advancing drip fails with no-progress message
- fake-timer advancing `completed` continues past several shortened no-progress windows
- **NEW** fake-timer status-only finalization ("verifying sha256 digest" → "writing manifest" → ...) survives past shortened watchdog
- loopback negative control: drip + idle stays unsettled
- loopback positive control: non-advancing drip rejects with no-progress
- **NEW** loopback status-only finalization: distinct status transitions ("verifying sha256 digest" → "writing manifest" → "pulling manifest" → "checking blob" → "cleanup") survive past 100ms budget under `streamNoProgressTimeoutMs: 100`
- loopback advancing `completed` finishes successfully past shortened budget

### Diff hygiene

- `oxfmt` on touched files; `git diff --check` clean
- Touched: `extensions/ollama/src/setup.ts`, `setup.pull.test.ts`, `setup.pull-deadline.loopback.test.ts`

### What was not tested

Live `ollama.com` / LAN Ollama daemon multi-hour large-model pull; controlled local drip + advancing `completed` + status-only finalization only.

### Fix classification

bugfix — timeout/hang

### Risk / Compatibility

Low. Removes the previous unconditional one-hour total cutoff. Retains headers + byte-idle. Adds semantic no-progress reset on both `completed` advances and distinct status transitions (default 300s budget). Test-only timeout overrides only (no new config/env). Intentional fail-closed for indefinitely non-advancing drips; healthy status-only finalization now explicitly covered.

## AI Assistance

AI-assisted. Author reviewed the idle-vs-no-progress contract, first-chunk arming, completed+status reset, advancing-progress and status-finalization regressions, loopback negative/positive/advancing/status-finalization controls, and proof before refresh.

Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)
